question: TC–RAG 的 Stack of Memory 七元组各元素表示什么？最终状态需要满足什么条件？
ground_truth: TC–RAG 用 (S,A,M,δ,s0,F,σ) 表示栈记忆：S 是状态集合，A 是动作集合，M 是栈记忆，δ 是状态转移函数，s0 是初始状态，F 是最终状态集合，σ 是最终状态超阈值；只有当前动作是 Conclusion 且状态值 f<σ 时才判定为最终状态。
contexts: Definition 1 (Stack of Memory): TC = (S, A, M, δ, s0, F, σ). S is the set of possible states; A is the action set; M is the infinite stack memory; δ maps the current state and memory to a new state, action and memory; s0 is the initial state; F is the set of final states; σ is the hyper-threshold. A state f is final if the current action is Conclusion and the current state value satisfies f < σ; otherwise Conclusion becomes Thought or the state is reset.

question: TC–RAG 如何定义 conditional perplexity 和 uncertainty？当系统状态值 st<σ 时表示什么？
ground_truth: conditional perplexity 为 cppl(Mtop|Mbottom)=exp(-1/N Σ_i log P(wi|w1,...,wi−1,Mbottom))；uncertainty 由输出分布熵计算，uct(Mtop)=−Σ_i P(wi|w1,...,wi−1) log P(wi|w1,...,wi−1)。当 st<σ 时，输出更可预测且更有信心，说明与原查询对齐。
contexts: System Value Calculation: cppl(Mtop | Mbottom) = exp(−1/N Σ(i=1..N) log P(wi | w1,...,wi−1,Mbottom)). Uncertainty uct(Mtop) is derived from the entropy of the output probability distribution as −Σ(i=1..N) P(wi | w1,...,wi−1) log P(wi | w1,...,wi−1). If st < σ, the output is predictable and confident and is aligned with the original query; a high value requires refinement.

question: TC–RAG 的 Push、Pop、Backtrack 和 Summary 动作分别如何管理记忆？
ground_truth: Push 在新信息或工具观察到达时把新动作压入栈；Pop 在检测到错误或不一致时移除栈顶并回到先前状态；Backtrack 触发 Thought 的弹出以恢复先前状态；Summary 先弹出栈顶内容再将其压缩总结后压回，以保持栈聚焦。
contexts: Meta-actions and memory management: Push adds a new action when the medical LLM processes new information or obtains tool observations. Pop removes the top element from the stack when an error or inconsistency is detected and reverts to the previous state. Backtrack pops a Thought and restores the previous state value. Summary pops the top content, summarizes it, and pushes the summary back so the stack remains focused.

question: Chart2Code-160k 的直接生成流程如何从代码得到数据集？请给出 chart type、模板代码、初始代码量和过滤后规模。
ground_truth: 作者确定 27 种常见 chart type，并为每种手写 79 个模板代码；LLM 生成并执行约 200k 个代码片段，过滤像素或刻度异常的图表后得到 160k 个 <chart,image instruction,code> 对。
contexts: Direct Chart-to-code Generation: the authors identify 27 chart types and manually write 79 template codes for each as in-context demonstrations. The process yields 200k code snippets; execute and filter problematic charts such as excessive pixels or ticks, then construct Chart2Code-160k with 160k multimodal instruction samples in the form <chart, instruction, code>.

question: ChartCoder 的三个模块分别是什么？视觉编码器、连接器和语言骨干使用了哪些具体模型？
ground_truth: ChartCoder 由预训练视觉编码器、视觉语言连接器和 Code LLM backbone 组成，具体为 SigLIP-384、两层 MLP 和 DeepSeek Coder 6.7B；模型还使用 Any Resolution 处理高分辨率图表。
contexts: Model Architecture: ChartCoder consists of a pre-trained vision encoder (SigLIP-384), a vision-language connector (two-layer MLP), and a Code LLM backbone (DeepSeek Coder 6.7B). It uses an Any Resolution strategy to preserve general and detailed chart information.
